title.en: An Act to Amend Section One of Republic Act Numbered Two Thousand Seven Hundred Five, as Amended, Entitled “An Act Prescribing the Duties and Qualifications, and Fixing the Number and Salaries, of the Members of the Legal Staff in the Office of the Secretary of Justice”

text.en: Such sums as may be necessary for the salary increases herein provided for the members of the legal staff, and for the salaries of such other complementary personnel in the legal research, library and stenographic staffs as well as for maintenance and other operating expenses and equipment, are hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, in addition to the appropriation provided in the General Appropriations Act for the legal staff for the ensuing fiscal year. Henceforth appropriations to cover salaries and other expenses of the legal staff as herein provided shall be carried in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
